import re
from collections import Counter

anagram_text = "In one of the Bards best thought of tragedies, our insistent hero, Hamlet, queries on two fronts about how life turns rotten."

def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z]', '', s.lower())

anagram_letters = normalize(anagram_text)

candidates = [
    "To be or not to be that is the question whether tis nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune",
    "To be or not to be that is the question",
    "Whether tis nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune",
]

for line in candidates:
    print(line, len(normalize(line)))
    print("match:", Counter(anagram_letters) == Counter(normalize(line)))
    print("----")
